create_minimax_solver: create a minimax solver for a game string like tic_tac_toe using MinimaxSolver
solve_game_minimax: solve a game using the minimax solver to compute optimal action values
run_minimax_example: run the minimax solver example with a configurable game string via argparse
get_action_values: get minimax action values from a game state using action_values_from_state
play_game_with_solver: play a game to completion using minimax action values to select best actions
